resources.string: Lets InstaTap show its floating target and tap the point you choose. InstaTap does not read or record anything on your screen.
1. Turn on the InstaTap accessibility service
Settings opens. Find InstaTap under Installed apps or Downloaded services and turn it on.
Android 13 or newer: if the switch is greyed out, open App info for InstaTap, tap the ⋮ menu, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Extra delay between taps (ms). 0 = as fast as possible
Drag the red target onto the button you want tapped, then press Start. Drag the control bar by its handle to move it.
